component_rules: Extract repeated channel identifier labels, string normalization and copy behavior into shared admin utilities/components.
Extract repeated catalog category/model selection into shared rental catalog helpers used by device and configuration pages.
Route order persistence, mapping changes, remark replay and historical backfill through one reconciliation service.
Route model/date mutation decisions through one fulfillment update guard.
Keep remark parsing independent from assignment, delivery, inspection, refund and settlement state transitions.

planned_extractions.name: channel identifier presentation
planned_extractions.trigger: Identifier label or copy behavior is needed in more than one surface.

planned_extractions.name: catalog model selection
planned_extractions.trigger: Configuration and rental-device pages require the same category/model semantics.

planned_extractions.name: order reconciliation
planned_extractions.trigger: A second caller needs to re-evaluate identifiers, mapping, remark plan or preparation status.

planned_extractions.name: fulfillment update guard
planned_extractions.trigger: Model or rental-date changes can encounter assigned or later lifecycle states.
